changes: Independent profile name; the daemon and host signal peer uses Moby's unconfined fallback.
AppArmor 4 ABI and explicit userns creation for the trusted namespace bootstrap.
Replace deny mount with mount allowance; outer capabilities exclude SYS_ADMIN and the worker drops all capabilities.
Allow only the two fixed root pivots used by pinned bubblewrap 0.8; preserve all other Docker default rules.
limitations: AppArmor profile loading is a host operator requirement, not an AgentArts cloud capability claim.
The application must still pass its namespace probe and install worker BPF; no UID-only fallback is permitted.
